about_the_game:
Into The Gloom is a gripping first-person horror adventure inspired by retro graphics, where fear and suspense take center stage.

In the demo, you'll uncover the first steps of a dark, enigmatic narrative, solve challenging puzzles, and face moments of creeping dread that hint at the full game’s deeper horrors.

This demo offers a taste of the game's unique atmosphere, spine-chilling soundtrack, and interactive story, giving you a chance to immerse yourself in the dark before diving into the complete experience.

The game’s terror stems not just from monsters, but the unsettling atmosphere and unpredictable jump scares. “The Shadow” is always lurking—ready to chase you when you least expect it.

Unlike typical item-based puzzles, Into The Gloom introduces dynamic, thought-provoking challenges that demand more than simple logic.

For the most immersive experience, headphones are highly recommended. Prepare to face the unknown, solve mysteries, and run for your life in this atmospheric pixel-style horror game!

content_descriptors.notes: Players can expect 2D pixel-style violence, gore, blood, presence of dead bodies. Depiction of suicide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and later
  • Processor: 1.6 GHz or better
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 160 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 and later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual core or equivalent
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 Gb
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended

short_description: Step into the eerie, unsettling world of Into The Gloom with this exclusive demo. Experience the gripping introduction to this retro-styled psychological horror game. Traverse a minimalist pixel-art environment where every shadow hides a mystery, and every sound builds tension.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Turkish, German, Japanese, Russian
